Yes.  I have read  this series twice all the way through, and there are even some characters I didn't like much at first, that I now have come to respect, admire, and even love after re-reading.  Some of them of course, are not so likeable, ever...  I love these books.  They grow on me, and in me!  and stick with you.  The characters are so real, and full of depth, I guess that is why it changes as you understand it more...  That's what I think anyway...
